review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for other uses of foldMap, Traversable.toList/foldl, Monoid.Foldl/Foldr and any Foldable-style class. Only this file defines or uses them, so there is no competing Traversable fold API elsewhere. The only plausible overlap is Foldl/Foldr, which are built on CategoryTheory.End of a type. Mathlib also has Function.End (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/End.lean), a monoid of endofunctions on a type. Its docstring says it "is generalized by `CategoryTheory.End` to categories other than `Type u`". The file's choice therefore uses the documented generalisation, and the same machinery is needed for the Kleisli variants foldlM/foldrM, which use End (KleisliCat.mk m α). Using Function.End for Foldl/Foldr would remove some ConcreteCategory.hom, asHom and ↾ conversions. But that is a representation choice, not an independent competing concept, and I could not show a practical cost beyond that. The Traversable.foldl, foldr, toList and length definitions are named specialisations of foldMap and have no Mathlib or core duplicates that I found. I did not search Lean core or Batteries for the List fold lemmas, because the file only applies them. Remaining uncertainty is small: some other Mathlib structure could overlap with Foldl/Foldr, but my grep found none.
